alt: Farah, Demir and Nazari review an early arrival and shrinking gaps on the bridge display.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Recompose the LAST reference into a 1536x1024 landscape Deep Orbit lesson scene. References 1 through 3 are canonical identity authorities in this order: dr-farah, chief-nazari, ensign-demir. Reference 4 is the room authority; reference 5 is the original edit target for story action, lighting and palette only. Preserve exact recognizable canonical facial structure, eye spacing, nose, jaw, mouth, complexion, age and signature equipment. Exactly 3 humans, the named cast only. Preserve balanced adult proportions and candid expressions. Exactly two complete arms per person, each from its own shoulder through one elbow and neutral wrist to one plausible hand. Ordinary thumb sides, fingers and natural object contact; no extra arm or bent prop. No camera-facing portraits. Faces visible naturally three-quarter with eyes directed toward work or each other. Use available empty wall or upper space for a large upright primary lesson display that is physically plausible and faces its operators. All text and lines follow the display plane, crisp and generously sized with comfortable margins. Keep essential content fully visible. Never put the sole lesson evidence upside down on paper or flat table, or on a tiny tabletop screen beneath a blank wall. Secondary paper can face its owner, but essential content is repeated upright. Remove meaningless decorative technical labels. No generic success verdicts, invented numbers, speech bubbles, watermarks or signatures. Dr. Farah: medium-brown skin, dark tied hair, gray lab coat, earrings and translucent green AR lens over her left eye. Chief Nazari: mature woman, silver-streaked dark bob, weathered tan face and olive engineering coveralls. Ensign Demir: young adult man, light warm skin with freckles, thick dark swept hair, short stubble, charcoal jumpsuit and green ear device.
Specific action and staging: Farah uses the console to collect interval evidence, focused and concerned. Demir leans beside her with one hand braced on the table and the other resting on the chair back, glancing from her to the report. Chief Nazari stands to the side with a skeptical expression, one hand relaxed on the rail and a closed notebook in the other. Exactly these three people. Move all needed timing evidence from upside-down notes to one large upright shared report.
Exact visible display content: Title "Timing review". Table "Forecast 03:12", "Observed 03:08", "4 minutes early". Separate clearly labeled archive anchors: "Initial pulse gap: 73.4 seconds" and "Initial larger cycle: 47 minutes". Under both: "Both measured gaps are shrinking". Footer "Cause and zero date unresolved". Do not imply the two intervals are equal or current measurements.
